doc.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Opening greetings and congratulations on the honorary degree
summary: Monk Rowe opens the second interview; the two joke about 'Doctor' titles and Davern's Hamilton honorary degree.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we’re in Clearwater Beach for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have a second opportunity to speak with Kenny Davern.
Thank you. It was a real honor indeed. Yeah.
Yeah. That was a good weekend. I’m looking at your whole career, and it’s a lengthy one, and I’m expecting a lot more from you, 10, 15, 20 years down the road, don’t you think?
I’m just trying to make it day by day. I don’t buy any green bananas to quote Flip Phillips.
